task_and_failure: Compare native memory lifecycle on frozen fictional notes in isolated stores; retain the initial unwanted default-model download attempt and corrected explicit-none embedding run.
discovery_provenance: Basic Memory was a sealed independent source-review recommendation and already a current catalog challenger.

Owned worker used native help and pinned source to qualify isolated stores and provider controls. First unset-provider attempt violated the no-model-download rule; one corrected explicit-none run was retained.
license_and_compatibility: ai-memory MIT code and Basic Memory AGPL-3.0; local synthetic existing-host trial only, no complete license audit. Basic Memory source was pinned, dependencies resolved at execution and retained; installed ai-memory binary hash/version are known, source equivalence not rebuilt.

baseline_and_candidate.baseline: Installed ai-memory 2.3.2 using an isolated synthetic store.
baseline_and_candidate.candidate: Pinned Basic Memory 0.23.2 in its own environment and synthetic notes project.

predeclared_metrics.quality_rule: Frozen three-note literal keywords/facts, one overwrite and one deletion. Native calls must return the expected current content; model downloads forbidden. No semantic recall benchmark.
predeclared_metrics.usage_rule: Preserve exact native outputs, failed attempt and measured individual process durations. No comparable latency or provider-savings claim; coordinator/worker usage unavailable.

runtime_and_platform.platform: Existing Linux/WSL x86_64 host; owned temporary prefixes/stores
runtime_and_platform.isolation: Constructed child environments, explicit local project/store/server URL and owned loopback server PIDs. No active real-store content or credential load. First ai-memory attempt fetched default model background; no completed model files found, egress unmeasured. Corrected explicit-none lane retained. No OS-enforced network sandbox.

commands: Original initial driver: python3 <OWNED_PRIVATE_PROBE>/probe.py; native argv/env/results retained with disclosed publication substitutions in attempt-1-default-embedding/commands.json; executed script original hash is in provenance.json.

Corrected driver: python3 <OWNED_PRIVATE_PROBE>/probe.py; ai-memory explicit AI_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=none, reuses original Basic Memory lane; native argv/env/results with disclosed publication substitutions in commands.json; executed script hash in provenance.json.

failures_and_skips.reason: Native content checks returned successfully, but unset embedding provider initiated background model download, violating the explicit trial condition. No completed model file found after stopping; network bytes unmeasured. Failed trial preserved.

limitations: Record assembled after native execution from retained frozen input and command evidence.
Accepted evidence consists of 21 ai-memory CLI calls plus two servers and 20 reused Basic Memory CLI calls; original Basic evidence appears in both packets and must not be counted twice.
ai-memory restore/reindex not run because guard checks sibling processes; Basic Memory reindex is not lost-database restoration.
Deletion concerns current search results, not physical erasure of history/logs/backups.
No semantic quality, cross-project isolation, hook/client integration, real corpus, concurrent/crash recovery or clean destination-PC qualification.
Public copies sanitize personal executable paths and whitespace; private backup bytes are represented by hashes/inventories. Original/public mappings are preserved.

rollback: Retire only owned disposable stores/environment when evidence retention permits. Both owned ai-memory server processes were stopped. Real memory service/configuration were unchanged.
next_decision_changing_test: Use a preregistered representative memory corpus with Hindsight and Basic Memory against ai-memory, shared downstream model/context, grounded answers, abstention, supersession, isolation and actual clean-target restore; retain current store until required quality/lifecycle evidence supports change.
